name: List email campaign AI agent sessions
description: Call this when you need to know whether the user already has in-progress or past AI email-campaign-agent sessions before starting or resuming AI-assisted campaign creation — for example to decide between resuming an existing session and opening a new one, or to surface a session identifier that a later agent call needs. An empty list means no AI agent session exists for this account yet, so nothing can be resumed. This only reports sessions; use the regular campaign listing action to enumerate actual email campaigns, and the campaign creation action to build a campaign without the AI agent.
preconditions: The caller must be authenticated to a Brevo account with an active web-app session (the endpoint lives on the internal editor-api host, not the public API host).
The account must have access to the AI email campaign agent feature in the campaigns area.

sessions.description: The AI email-campaign-agent sessions belonging to the authenticated account. Observed empty ([]) for an account with no sessions; the shape of a populated entry was not observed and must not be assumed.

items.description: One AI email-campaign-agent session. No fields were observed, so treat the entry as opaque and read it rather than assuming keys.
